claude-code.notes: Skills live as directories (Claude Code reads frontmatter from SKILL.md). Agents are flat files at .claude/agents/<name>.md with frontmatter — we extract the inner agent.md. Hook scripts are stored under .claude/hooks/<name>.sh but must also be referenced from .claude/settings.json to actually run.

cursor.notes: Cursor's only persistent customization is project rules at .cursor/rules/<name>.mdc. Our skills land there as .mdc files with a Cursor-compatible frontmatter (description, globs, alwaysApply). No global scope: Cursor reads rules per-workspace.

antigravity.notes: Google Antigravity reads skills as directories containing SKILL.md. Workspace location is .agent/skills/; global at ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/. The assetPaths.skills value is empty so skills land at the target root.

gemini-cli.notes: Gemini CLI's skills support is evolving. This config places skills at ~/.gemini/skills/ (global) or .gemini/skills/ (workspace). Verify against your installed Gemini CLI version — earlier versions only honour a GEMINI.md context file.

vscode-copilot.notes: VS Code Copilot reads .github/instructions/<name>.instructions.md (custom instructions with applyTo frontmatter), .github/prompts/<name>.prompt.md (reusable prompts), and .github/chatmodes/<name>.chatmode.md (custom chat modes). For Copilot to pick the files up, the workspace setting chat.promptFiles must be enabled. No global scope: Copilot reads from the workspace .github/.

copilot-cli.notes: GitHub Copilot CLI (the newer agentic `copilot` command) reads .github/copilot-instructions.md plus the same .github/instructions/ and .github/prompts/ tree that VS Code Copilot uses. Global ~/.copilot/ supports user-wide instructions. Note: gh copilot (the older gh extension) does NOT consume these files — use this config for the new agentic CLI only.

kiro.notes: AWS Kiro reads markdown files from .kiro/steering/ to inject project-wide guidance into the agent. Hooks at .kiro/hooks/ also need a corresponding .kiro.hook JSON metadata file; this config installs the script only, you must register it via the Kiro UI or by hand-crafting the .kiro.hook file.

kiro-cli.notes: Treated as a sibling of Kiro IDE — shares .kiro/steering/ at workspace scope and supports a ~/.kiro/ user-wide steering directory. If your Kiro CLI build uses different paths, override this config or pass --target.
